summary: Public projects created on 30 November 2025: 5 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Jewish religious life and technology appear across several repositories: documentation collecting AI tools, Hebrew calendar and text study projects, an index of tech and Judaism work, and tests of Sefaria MCP servers. Voice work covers a Ragie pipeline, a prompt cleanup script, and a synthetic audio dataset of career narration.
